question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **severely**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Severely **means great seriousness, strictness, or rigor, often implying a significant level of negative consequence or impact. (अत्यधिक गंभीरता, सख्ती या कठोरता, जिसका अर्थ अक्सर महत्वपूर्ण स्तर का नकारात्मक परिणाम या प्रभाव होता है)

 
 
• **For example- ***The storm severely damaged an old tree.*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, "**severely**" is the appropriate word choice because it conveys the strong and intense nature of the criticism the writer received from the rev
